run_point_sup_training: run the point supervision training script with a config file and optional command line arguments
run_eval_only: run evaluation only mode to test a trained model on a dataset with test time augmentation
build_evaluator: build a COCO evaluator for a given dataset name and output folder using the Trainer class
build_train_loader: build a detection training data loader with optional point supervision dataset mapper from config
setup_config: setup and merge configuration from a config file with point rend and point sup options enabled
